hotels.title: Grand Opening: Sri Lanka Surf-Inspired Beachside Escape with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner & Cocktails
hotels.description: Surf, vinyl and long balmy nights spent on the rooftop: this brand-new Galle beachfront escape offers all three in abundance on Sri Lanka's mangrove-flecked southern coast, with the spectacular Indian Ocean a constant companion. Just a short drive from Galle Fort, it’s the first international hotel from the Otherland brand - and a fresh take on the Sri Lanka coastal stay, made for couples and friends who love beach days and cherish great design. Spend your mornings savouring barista-poured coffee at Bar-kery, the hotel's ground-floor café; after days spent chasing the surf, return to rooftop restaurant, cocktail bar and pool club Creatures for poolside pina coladas and DJ-led events.
